summary: Go SDK: streaming chat reader blocks indefinitely when server closes connection
description: Customer reports Go SDK streaming chat occasionally never returns from Next() after the server has closed the TCP connection. They suspect the SDK does not notice EOF promptly. Observed on go1.22, redwood-sdk-go v0.9.1. Impact: goroutines leak and request cancellation fails.
comments:
Support (Ben): Gathered goroutine dump showing blocked read on bufio.Reader.ReadString('
').
Eng (Hiro): Root cause: we wrap the response body in a scanner with too-large token and ignore scanner.Err(); also not wiring context cancellation to body close.
Eng (Hiro): Fix: use bufio.Reader with explicit context-aware Close, check errors, and return terminal error on EOF. Released v0.9.2.
Support (Ben): Customer confirms no more goroutine leaks after upgrade.
